findings.text: Classic Tasks statistics printer exposes a labelled diagnostic entry that selects the classic instance and delegates to the shared generic printer with an empty qualifier.
Rude Tasks statistics printer exposes a labelled diagnostic entry that selects the rude instance and delegates to the shared generic printer with an empty qualifier.

Shared Tasks printer reports grace period identity with timing and state name, queue tuning with progress markers, per processor pending work totals, and barrier sequence timing with counts plus processors still outstanding, allocating a temporary processor set for the holdout computation and releasing it afterwards while tolerating racy observation.

Grace period state naming converts a numeric state to a table entry and substitutes a placeholder when the value lies outside the table, intentionally combining racy observation with a stable read to surface races without repeated compiler loads.

A scale descriptor covers a sleepable flavor, associating setup with teardown, read side bracketing, normal with expedited progress observation under a difference rule, asynchronous submission, barrier, normal with expedited waits, and statistics under a short label.
Classic and rude read side scale helpers impose no protection in these fragments: the lock path reports constant success and the unlock path ignores its argument and leaves no state.
Tracing read side scale helpers enter and exit a tracing read side region around a constant success indicator, providing real bracketing unlike the vacuous classic and rude helpers.

A scale descriptor covers the classic tasks flavor, binding shared synchronous setup, vacuous read side helpers, a fixed no progress observer with a sequence difference rule, asynchronous submission with barrier, unified normal with expedited waits, a grace period thread accessor, and conditional statistics under a short label.

A scale descriptor covers the rude tasks flavor, binding shared synchronous setup, vacuous read side helpers, a fixed no progress observer with a sequence difference rule, unified normal with expedited waits, a grace period thread accessor, and conditional statistics under a short label, omitting asynchronous and barrier roles in the visible fragment.

A scale descriptor covers the tracing tasks flavor, binding shared synchronous setup, real tracing read side helpers, a fixed no progress observer with a sequence difference rule, tracing asynchronous submission with barrier, and unified tracing waits under a short label, omitting thread accessor and statistics roles in the visible fragment.
Flavor list macros have build variants that either contribute the corresponding descriptor reference with a separator for inclusion or expand to nothing for exclusion.
Sequence distance helper prefers the active descriptor difference rule when installed and otherwise uses plain arithmetic distance.
Shutdown waiter offers a voluntary quiescent hint, returns promptly while any writer remains unfinished, and otherwise sleeps uninterruptibly until a stop request arrives.

Reader worker binds to a processor derived from its argument, lowers its priority, signals that it has started, then repeats a masked interrupt read side open and close pair interleaved with shutdown waiting until asked to stop.

Expedited worker binds similarly, raises its priority, honors an optional initial idle pause, then repeats an optional fine delay followed by an expedited wait with shutdown waiting until asked to stop.

Per writer block allocator serves from a writer private list, refilling that list in bulk from the same writer shared reserve when empty, and reports absence when reserves are missing or exhausted, with a rate limited warning if the top level table is absent.

Block release tolerates an absent block and otherwise returns the block to the shared reserve of its origin list; the asynchronous completion path decrements that origin outstanding count before release.

Writer worker moves through affinity with scheduling setup and optional pauses, boot gating unless expedited, a start barrier capturing time with progress baselines, a timed measurement loop using asynchronous versus expedited versus normal waits with overload fallback to barrier, duration capture with completion accounting and stall diagnostics and optional poweroff, and terminal barrier with publication of counts.

Scale teardown validates that the observed expedited versus normal mix matches the requested mode, optionally reports grace period thread processor consumption, stops expedited with reader and writer groups, summarizes per writer completion counts with overall timing and batch progress and per measurement durations, checks that asynchronous reserves balance, releases tables, and runs flavor specific teardown.
Alternative teardown for kfree mode stops expedited with kfree reader groups and releases their task tables before closing the torture session.

Global grace period thread shower exposes a diagnostic entry that dumps overall state, highlights tree nodes with processors carrying outstanding work while skipping idle ones, totals invoked callbacks across processors, and includes offload with Tasks summaries.

Tasks thread shower aggregates across processors whether callbacks exist, whether urgency is flagged, whether urgent callbacks exist, and whether a lazy timer is pending, then logs identity with state and uptime and progress and interrupt counts plus presence markers and lazy interval; thin wrappers select classic or rude or combined coverage.

Offload state shower opens with the leader grace period view, exits when the processor is not offloaded, otherwise reports queue with segment occupancy and bypass counts plus thread and lock and sleep and wait indicators with per segment presence markers, then warns when callback only processors show grace period activity. Leader view reports identity, thread with lock and defer and timer and sleep flags, wait activity, bypass with grace flags, normal with expedited sequences, tree range, loop counts, and thread state with placement.

An offload shower variant is intentionally empty for builds without the feature; the placement marker has an informative variant that flags a running but off processor thread and an always empty variant.

Reader scale work masks interrupts across the read side pair; per writer private reserve is treated as exclusive owner while the shared reserve accepts cross context returns; diagnostics observe shared counters with locks without acquiring them, accepting approximate values.

Several paths assume global tables, duration stores, and active descriptor vectors are present, with only sparse warnings, so misconfiguration risks invalid dereference; diagnostic walks read live per processor and tree state racily, so output may be torn and must not drive control decisions.
Scale descriptors advertise stable short flavor labels for selection and log correlation, namely srcud and tasks and tasks-rude and tasks-tracing.
Classic and rude descriptors suppress their statistics callback when the tiny build is selected, otherwise they provide their respective Tasks statistics printers.
Scale statistics shims forward the currently selected type with flag labels to the matching classic or rude Tasks torture printer.
